verses.text: To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.
lines: To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.

verses.text: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
lines: My God, I have trusted in you.
Don’t let me be shamed.
Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.

verses.text: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
lines: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed.
They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.

verses.text: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
lines: Show me your ways, Yahweh.
Teach me your paths.

verses.text: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.
lines: Guide me in your truth, and teach me,
For you are the God of my salvation,
I wait for you all day long.

verses.text: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.
lines: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness,
for they are from old times.

verses.text: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.
lines: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions.
Remember me according to your loving kindness,
for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.

verses.text: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
lines: Good and upright is Yahweh,
therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.

verses.text: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
lines: He will guide the humble in justice.
He will teach the humble his way.

verses.text: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
lines: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth
to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

verses.text: For your name’s sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
lines: For your name’s sake, Yahweh,
pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

verses.text: What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
lines: What man is he who fears Yahweh?
He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.

verses.text: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.
lines: His soul will dwell at ease.
His offspring will inherit the land.

verses.text: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
lines: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him.
He will show them his covenant.

verses.text: My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
lines: My eyes are ever on Yahweh,
for he will pluck my feet out of the net.

verses.text: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
lines: Turn to me, and have mercy on me,
for I am desolate and afflicted.

verses.text: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
lines: The troubles of my heart are enlarged.
Oh bring me out of my distresses.

verses.text: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
lines: Consider my affliction and my travail.
Forgive all my sins.

verses.text: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
lines: Consider my enemies, for they are many.
They hate me with cruel hatred.

verses.text: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
lines: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me.
Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.

verses.text: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
lines: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me,
for I wait for you.

verses.text: Redeem Israel, God, out of all his troubles.
lines: Redeem Israel, God,
out of all his troubles.
